entries.value: Mert left the building at 08.27. Elif entered the flat at 11.48 to collect her remaining things, and on leaving at 12.16 she left the key in the flowerpot beside the door. Hasan knew where the key was from an earlier incident between neighbours. During the interval with no camera recording he took the key and entered the flat; he took the laptop, the watch and the money, and took the key with him when he left. Elif’s first statement was false; what she was hiding was not a theft but an unannounced visit.

The building record showed Elif’s entry and exit, but there was no footage between 12.37 and 13.08. No sign of forced entry was found on the door. Mert’s account of the key in the flowerpot and Elif’s statement that she left the key there were assessed together with the hand-over record. The missing laptop’s serial number LQ7B-024861 matched the device handed in to a shop in the name of Hasan Kaya at 14.10 on the day of the incident. The watch and the cash were not recovered separately.

Someone lying does not automatically make them the culprit; nor does being the complainant or a neighbour put anyone outside the investigation. Statements, the limits of records and independent documents must be weighed together.
Mert Aydın reports that when he got home his laptop, his watch and his cash were missing. There is no sign of forced entry on the door. The first report is on your desk.

A search of Hasan Kaya’s flat turned up the watch and part of the money. The laptop was recovered by the serial number on the shop receipt and returned to Mert Aydın. Kaya was taken into custody to stand trial.

Elif Demir was taken into custody on suspicion of theft and spent two nights in a holding cell. She was released when the serial number turned up at another address. The last tie between her and Mert Aydın was broken too; Hasan Kaya’s flat was never searched.

Mert Aydın’s complaint was put under review on suspicion of a false report, and the insurance payment was frozen. Weeks later the review closed without result. In the meantime the belongings changed hands and their trail went cold.
